tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: Workspace ground: the window behind every pane, input wells in dialogs and fields.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Workspace chrome: header, tab strip, footer, sidebars, palette, settings cards.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: menus, toasts, switch tracks, secondary buttons in panes.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Hover and active fill for icon buttons, menu items, tab close; empty meter track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every 1px hairline in the workspace: pane borders, tab dividers, menu edges, field borders.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-0 to bg-3.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, idle tab labels, footer text, icon-button glyphs on bg-0 to bg-3.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary meta text: palette section labels, placeholders, pin glyph. Source value kept: about 3.2:1 on bg-1 in dark and 3.5:1 on white in light, below 4.5:1, so keep it to non-essential hints.

tokens.name: side-tint
tokens.usage: Left sidebar ground when Appearance > Sidebar is Tinted: bg-1 with a faint accent wash. Text-1 and text-2 keep their contrast on it.

tokens.name: term
tokens.usage: Terminal and editor ground; the selected tab takes it so the tab joins its pane.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand blue in the workspace: selected-tab top rule, on switches, merged PR dot, the mark.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Agent working state, meter fill, Codex chip. Text on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: signal-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind signal text (Codex chip).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs-you state, pending checks, warn tag, meter over threshold. Text on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text (warn tag).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Tab colour 8 and squad accents. Text on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: violet-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind violet text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done state, passing checks, open PR, added-line count. Always paired with a word or the +N figure.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed state, destructive menu items, deleted-line count, closed PR. Always paired with a word or the -N figure.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text (skipped-tab pill).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Claude Code agent chip and tab colour 2. Text on bg-0 to bg-2.

tokens.name: orange-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind orange text (Claude chip).

tokens.name: brand-agent
tokens.usage: Logo v9 agent cursor only: the bar after the × in BrandMark and the lockups. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: badge-ink-dark
tokens.usage: Ink on a custom badge fill that is light (picked from the fill luminance).

tokens.name: badge-ink-light
tokens.usage: Ink on a custom badge fill that is dark (picked from the fill luminance).

tokens.name: x-color-bg
tokens.usage: Semantic layer (@xdev/ui): page ground of the docs app and site. Inside workspace surfaces it is remapped to bg-0.

tokens.name: x-color-panel
tokens.usage: Semantic panel: activity bar, dialogs.

tokens.name: x-color-surface
tokens.usage: Semantic surface: segmented track, select, dialog inputs.

tokens.name: x-color-surface-2
tokens.usage: Semantic hover fill; neutral badge ground.

tokens.name: x-color-ink
tokens.usage: Semantic text on x-color-bg, panel, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: x-color-muted
tokens.usage: Semantic secondary text on x-color-bg, panel and surface.

tokens.name: x-color-line
tokens.usage: Semantic hairline: secondary buttons, segmented, dialog edge.

tokens.name: x-color-accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, pressed segment, current activity.

tokens.name: x-color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on x-color-accent (5.2:1 dark, 6.6:1 light).

tokens.name: x-color-accent-soft

tokens.name: x-color-signal

tokens.name: x-color-signal-soft
tokens.usage: Changed badge ground.

tokens.name: x-color-warn-line

tokens.name: x-color-ok

tokens.name: x-color-ok-soft
tokens.usage: New badge ground.

tokens.name: x-color-danger
tokens.usage: Error text, crash detail.

tokens.name: x-color-danger-soft

tokens.name: x-color-code-bg
